sentences.en: It took me a long time to recover from pneumonia.
sentences.zh: 我从肺炎中恢复花了很长时间。

sentences.en: He's got pneumonia. No wonder he is coughing nonstop.
sentences.zh: 他得了肺炎。难怪他在不停地咳嗽。

sentences.en: He was diagnosed with pneumonia after contracting the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 他感染了新冠病毒后被诊断出患有肺炎。
